general: Leave is an accrued entitlement that must be correct on the first day in the new system — an incorrect leave balance is noticed immediately at the first leave request.

This tab contains the starting position of the leave balances per employee per leave type, as an opening balance on the go-live date of AFAS. Below are the columns with example data and frequently asked questions.

Medewerker.description: Employee number in AFAS. Must match the Medewerker column in the employee file. Note: multiple rows per employee are possible (one per leave type/financial year).

Type Verlof.description: Leave code in AFAS. Usually contains the year (W2025 = statutory 2025, B2025 = above-statutory 2025), so the table differs per year and per client. Checked against the leave type table in the AFAS environment of this project.

Boekjaar.description: The financial year the balance relates to. Use the year that matches the year in the leave code. Needed when leave from several years is present at the same time.

Datum Boeking.description: The booking date of this leave correction. If you leave this empty, the tool chooses itself: if the Boekjaar falls in the year of go-live, the go-live date; otherwise 31 December of the Boekjaar.

Huidig Saldo (in Uren).description: Leave balance in hours on the reference date. Max. 2 decimals, point as the decimal separator. A negative balance is only possible if employees are allowed to go negative or have accrued enough in the new year. Tip: check deviations of more than 1 hour compared with the source system before importing.

faq.question: What is the Boekjaar column for?
faq.answer: Boekjaar links the balance to a specific leave accrual year. It also ensures a financial reservation of leave in that year.

faq.question: How do I determine the leave balance on the reference date?
faq.answer: Export the leave registration from the source system as at the agreed conversion reference date. Check per leave type: accrued leave minus taken leave = the balance to import in the column Huidig Saldo.

faq.question: Which leave types can I import?
faq.answer: You can import all leave types that were implemented when the terms of employment were set up for the employee in AFAS.
